## DoorDash Launches Drone Delivery Service Amid Ongoing Fair-Value Debate

Drone delivery represents a meaningful autonomous logistics step for DoorDash, but the paired fair-value uncertainty signals investors are not yet pricing in a positive return; the key watch item is whether unit economics can justify the capital required to scale this capability.

- DoorDash announced the launch of a drone delivery capability.
- Coverage pairs the operational expansion with a continuing debate about the stock's fair value.
- Market skepticism on the cost economics of autonomous logistics is implied by the framing.
